description: AstroQuad brings together four curious minds with one shared mission: to turn space-inspired ideas into practical solutions. Competing in the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we combine creativity, coding, and teamwork to explore challenges on Earth and beyond. We’re here to learn, build, and make every idea count.
summary:
Tales from the Cosmic Graveyard is an educational storybook and media experience designed to introduce school-age space enthusiasts (ages 8–14) to the hardware left behind across the solar system and the science it accomplished. Addressing the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge, our project gives a dramatic first-person "voice" to four historic artifacts: the Apollo 11 Eagle Descent Stage on the Moon, the Opportunity Rover on Mars, the Ingenuity Mars Helicopter, and the Voyager 1 interstellar probe.

We developed a narrative presentation deck, custom script, and video experience that connect physical hardware engineering—such as Kapton foil insulation, quartz retroreflectors, rocker-bogie suspensions, and RTG power units—directly to groundbreaking scientific discoveries. This project is important because it transforms discarded space equipment from perceived "space junk" into enduring planetary monuments. It preserves off-world history and inspires the next generation of engineers to explore the cosmos.
details:
Tales from the Cosmic Graveyard is an educational storytelling project created for students aged 8 to 14 to explore NASA equipment left behind on the Moon, Mars, and in interstellar space. Instead of treating these historic spacecraft as discarded space junk, our project personifies them as silent planetary monuments. Through a first-person narrative approach called the Voice of the Machine, we bring to life four iconic missions: the Apollo 11 Eagle descent stage at Tranquility Base, the Opportunity rover across the Martian dunes, the Ingenuity helicopter executing powered flight in Mars' thin atmosphere, and the Voyager 1 probe traveling into the interstellar medium with humanity's Golden Record.

We created our project deliverables using Gamma AI to design and structure our presentation deck, Kling AI to generate high-quality visual video scenes of the planets and spacecraft, and AI audio tools to formulate the voiceover narration and soundtrack. This approach allows us to connect physical engineering components directly to NASA's groundbreaking scientific discoveries while keeping the material engaging and emotionally resonant. By delivering our final project as a PDF presentation deck and a short video trailer, we ensure that judges, educators, and young space enthusiasts can easily view and interact with the content on any device without technical barriers.
